title.en: HonestCI: a green process can contain zero tests
title.zh: HonestCI：綠燈的流程可能一個測試都沒跑

summary.en: A runner exits 0 while its JUnit report records zero tests; HCI004_ZERO_TESTS blocks it. Why exit codes and test counts are different signals.
summary.zh: 執行器退出碼 0，JUnit 報告卻記錄零個測試；HCI004_ZERO_TESTS 把它擋下來。為什麼退出碼與測試數是兩個不同的訊號。

title.en: RigorGraph: keep claims connected to their evidence
title.zh: RigorGraph：讓主張和證據連在一起

summary.en: Changed evidence bytes surface as RG_HASH_MISMATCH; a changed claim invalidates its old acceptance. A hash answers identity, not sufficiency.
summary.zh: 證據位元組改變會以 RG_HASH_MISMATCH 浮現；主張改變會讓舊的接受失效。雜湊回答的是同一性，不是充分性。

title.en: Finite Witness: make a counterexample inspectable
title.zh: Finite Witness：讓反例可以被檢查

summary.en: Candidate 39 is C₄. The certificate records the prefix actually searched, not the range requested; people and WebMCP agents inspect the same engine.
summary.zh: 第 39 個候選是 C₄。憑證記錄的是實際搜尋過的前綴，不是請求的範圍；人和 WebMCP agent 檢查同一個引擎。

title.en: ProofWeave: certify a formal target without overstating its meaning
title.zh: ProofWeave：認證形式目標，但不誇大它的意義

summary.en: Lean certified one obligation; statement alignment stayed UNCONFIRMED. Formal validity and semantic alignment are separate axes and stay separate.
summary.zh: Lean 認證了一個義務；語意對齊仍是 UNCONFIRMED。形式有效性與語意對齊是兩個軸，而且保持分開。

title.en: SAIR Proof Press: retain a checkable answer through bounded search
title.zh: SAIR Proof Press：在有限搜尋中保住可檢查的答案

summary.en: Search routes propose candidates; Lean decides. Released-input results are bound to an evaluator commit, and the claim boundaries say what they do not show.
summary.zh: 搜尋路線提出候選，由 Lean 決定。公開輸入的結果綁定到評測器的 commit，主張邊界說明它們沒有證明的事。

title.en: MiniHarness: turn a curriculum outline into executable lessons
title.zh: MiniHarness：把課綱做成可執行的課程

summary.en: 38 Traditional Chinese modules, fixed checker contracts, and a kept negative result: adaptation improved a dev score while worsening held-out perplexity.
summary.zh: 38 個繁體中文模組、固定的檢查器契約，以及一個留下來的負面結果：微調讓開發分數上升，卻讓保留集的 perplexity 變差。

title.en: External contribution: keep Windows verification failures distinguishable
title.zh: 外部貢獻：讓 Windows 驗證失敗可區分

summary.en: A merged fix that narrows a native-window fallback so unrelated errors stay failures, and repairs standalone helper loading.
summary.zh: 已合併的修正：縮小原生視窗的降級判斷，讓不相關的錯誤仍然是失敗，並修好獨立執行時的輔助模組載入。
